entries.name: Stride
entries.summary: Spend one action to move up to your current Speed.
entries.beginnerTip: Choose a distance and movement mode; the app spends one of your three actions.

source.adaptation: Neutral functional sample; not imported from an upstream rules publication.

entries.name: Step
entries.summary: Spend one action on a short, careful movement.
entries.beginnerTip: Use this when careful positioning matters more than distance; ask the GM about terrain restrictions.

source.adaptation: Neutral functional sample; not imported from an upstream rules publication.

entries.name: Strike
entries.summary: Spend one action to attack with a weapon or unarmed option.
entries.beginnerTip: The app applies your current attack modifier and tracks earlier attacks in this turn.

source.adaptation: Neutral functional sample; not imported from an upstream rules publication.

entries.name: Three Actions
entries.summary: On a typical turn, choose activities whose total cost fits your remaining action tokens.
entries.beginnerTip: You can repeat many one-action choices, but repeated attacks may become less accurate.

source.adaptation: Original explanation of the application's generic three-action model.

entries.name: Degrees of Success
entries.summary: A check can produce one of four outcome bands instead of only success or failure.
entries.beginnerTip: Enter the GM's target when known; otherwise let the GM state the outcome band.

source.adaptation: Original explanation of a generic four-outcome model.

entries.name: Frightened
entries.summary: A valued condition used by this sample to demonstrate temporary penalties and automatic reduction.
entries.beginnerTip: Enter the condition value and its source so the app can explain every affected total.

source.adaptation: Neutral engine fixture; not authoritative rules text.
